cause: Profile message actions called the cross-tab navigation operation, replacing NavigationPath and removing the originating profile. Profile sheets additionally dismissed themselves before that replacement.
behavior: A profile already on the authenticated stack pushes the chat while retaining the selected tab and preceding routes.
A modal profile retains its own existing NavigationStack and profile state beneath the chat. It no longer dismisses itself to navigate.
Existing server-room and pending local-direct destinations are both supported.
Profile-owned chat and resource destinations share the same navigation owner; nested retry actions receive that owner through the interaction environment.
Global conversation shortcuts retain their existing cross-tab replacement behavior.

added_scenarios: Preserve a contact/request back stack for server-room and local-direct targets
Empty room identifiers leave the stack unchanged
Hosted modal profile navigates profile → chat → chat files → chat → profile without changing the outer path or selected tab

limits: The hosted file-route test uses an unavailable service fixture to verify routing ownership, not resource downloading.
New local-direct stack preservation is verified by navigation state; the hosted view exercise uses an existing server-room route.
Physical-device back gestures have not been manually verified.
The hosted profile test exercises the modal content NavigationStack directly, not system sheet-dismissal gestures.
